comment:
Quote: "Randomization was carried out by the Data Coordinating Center in
Pelotas; a computer-generated code was used for
randomization within balanced blocks of 20 women,
stratified according to center. A sequence of sealed,
opaque envelopes including the randomization codes
was used by a single investigator in each hospital to
assign the women to treatment groups. A particular
woman's group assignment was known only to this
investigator, the study supervisor and the home
visitor."
